title: My speaker said goodnight to someone else 🔊

hook_text: At 3:12 a.m. my speaker said goodnight to someone else.

scenes.narration: At 3:12 a.m. my speaker said goodnight to someone else.

shots.prompt: small smart speaker glowing blue on a dark bedside table, apartment at night

scenes.narration: I live alone. It said, goodnight, Daniel. I am not Daniel.

shots.prompt: dark apartment living room at night with a sofa and a window, blue moonlight

scenes.narration: I asked who it was talking to. It answered, the one behind you.

shots.prompt: close view of a small smart speaker with a ring of blue light, dark room

scenes.narration: My lamp was off. A shape stood in the dark doorway. My height. My posture. Waiting.

shots.prompt: tall dark human silhouette standing motionless in a dark apartment hallway doorway, backlit by faint blue light, no face, no details

scenes.narration: Then my own voice came out of the speaker. It said, I told you not to answer him.

shots.prompt: small smart speaker glowing blue in a dark room, reflection on the table

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you answer to it, or unplug it?
